title: [3.1.0.3] Glucose projection lines do not get redrawn immediately sometimes
symptom: After giving manual insulin bolus (in virtual pump (eros) but also in regular omnipod eros), the glucose projection lines do not get redrawn immediately even if SMB and the Loop tabs get refreshed manually. They get redrawn only if carbs are added (even 1 gram) or on next BG update.
fix: Improved in dev. Data is available after OAPS run.
evidence_quote: improved in dev. data is available after OAPS run
